verdicts.reason: A reads cleanly left to right: logo, then a one-line headline, then the CTA. Its flaws are a phone graphic cropped tight against the left and top/bottom edges, badges nearly as heavy as the CTA, and dead space at the far right. B breaks the brand lockup: SOLSTICE floats beside the headline, which is jammed into two lines. It also leaves a big empty gap between the phone and the text, makes the badge as wide as the CTA and stacked directly on it so they compete, and shrinks the subtitle to near-illegible size.
